title: Old wall paper
instructions: may be cleaned by rubbing with a loaf of stale bread. Cut the loaf in half and rub gently on the wall.
To rid the kitchen and closets of cockroaches,
put powdered borax in all corners and allow it to remain there all year. Renew every three months at least. This will postively rid a house of roaches.
In cutting hot bread use a hot knife, and it will not be clammy. In putting away knives wrap them in paper to prevent rusting. Never in woolen cloth.
